digest.component_or_area: ADR-0083 reconciler vendor adapter seam documentation
propositions: isinstance against @runtime_checkable Protocol is necessary but not sufficient on Python 3.12+ due to getattr_static behavior change, causing proxying transports with the capability to silently fail the check
ADR-0083 §193-197 prescribed isinstance-only capability detection which was safe on Python 3.11 but became unsafe on Python 3.12+ with CPython gh-102433, creating a version-boundary temporal decay
The correct guard shape is isinstance primary with member-level hasattr fallback, as implemented in _capability_present at dispatch_apply_phases.py:188
Tree-wide sweep found exactly one capability dispatch site and all adjacent hasattr checks already proxy-safe; no source code changes needed
